messages:
Ava: Quick kickoff — we need the SEO wiring for the webinar landing + benchmark post. Scope: final keyword map, schema markup for event + article, internal-link targets from blog -> landing, a redirect plan for old webinar pages, and clear inbound lead routing (UTMs -> HubSpot). timeline: launch in 10 days.

Tom: copying the latest kw list into the sheet now: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example - I trimmed to 8 focus keywords and 4 longtails for the benchmark narrative.

Maya: will take the hero + 3 supporting blog posts for internal link anchors. proposed anchors: "benchmark results", "cost vs latency", "webinar signup + replay".

Jules: can we get a tiny internal-link matrix? format: source -> target -> anchor text -> priority. I'll own the mapping and handoff to content.

Tom: putting a starter CSV in the sheet. also note schema: we should use Event schema for the webinar + Article schema for the post. include organizer, startDate, endDate, location (online), offers.priceSpecification if gated.

Elena: FYI we need consistent utm params for all CTAs to ensure HubSpot routing. suggested template: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1. Also confirm form capture uses incoming querystring to populate contact property.

Maya: layering messaging: hero focuses on "production inference economics", subhead points at latency & cost benchmarks. the blog will deep-dive methodology so it links to the benchmark appendix PDF (tracked).

Tom: redirect plan — old webinar pages we need to 301 -> new landing, but preserve any legacy campaign querystrings. example nginx rule I tested in staging: 
```
# preserve querystring and 301
location ~* ^/old-webinar/(.*)$ {
  return 301 https://redwood.example.com/webinars/new-landing?$query_string;
}
```
Tested on staging and the utms flowed through.

Jules: great — add a small QA checklist: verify meta titles, canonical tags, hreflang (if applicable), breadcrumbs, and schema output in Google Rich Results test.

Ava: can someone own redirects + staging test? want confirmation by EOD tomorrow. also we need the internal-link map by Tuesday so devs can add the CTAs in the nav and sidebars.

Tom: I'll own redirects + schema validation. will push a PR with nginx snippet and a short runbook for rollback.

Elena: I'll set up the HubSpot form mapping and a saved view for the webinar campaign. also will add GA4 event names: webinar_signup, webinar_replay_click.

Maya: content deliverables: hero copy draft by tomorrow, 3 supporting posts by Friday, appendix PDF with methods + raw numbers by Monday.

Jules: adding internal-link matrix to the sheet now — link priorities 1-3, recommended anchor variations. will ping devs for slotting.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-07-12T02:30Z for QA (redirect rules + schema).

Ava: thanks all. follow-ups: Tom confirm redirect PR link, Elena confirm HubSpot workflow name, Maya drop copy in the doc. we'll sync briefly in 1pm standup. :thumbsup:
